walkthrough.title: Get started with Daemonize
walkthrough.description: Create your first tool in a few minutes and let Kiro use it.
walkthrough.install.title: Install Daemonize
walkthrough.install.description:
Daemonize needs a small program on this computer.
[Install Daemonize](command:daemonize.installCli)
walkthrough.studio.title: Open the Studio
walkthrough.studio.description:
The Studio is the page where you see and test your tools.
[Open the Studio](command:daemonize.openStudio)
walkthrough.action.title: Create your first action
walkthrough.action.description:
Show Daemonize the first thing you do in your software. Do it once, then choose Finish.
[New action](command:daemonize.newAction)
walkthrough.test.title: Test it
walkthrough.test.description:
Run your action from the Studio and check that it works.
[Test in the Studio](command:daemonize.testInStudio)
walkthrough.kiro.title: Add it to Kiro
walkthrough.kiro.description:
Make your action available to Kiro, so that Kiro can use it in chat.
[Add to Kiro](command:daemonize.connectToKiro)
walkthrough.agent.title: Try the Daemonize agent
walkthrough.agent.description:
Tell the agent what you want to do. It builds the tool with you.
[Build a tool with the Daemonize agent](command:daemonize.buildWithAgent)
config.cliPath: Path of the Daemonize program. Leave empty to find it automatically.
config.nodePath: Path of Node. Leave empty to find it automatically.
